segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers, including one who is 64 with still-oily skin, say it cleans thoroughly and cuts oil/sebum without leaving their face dry.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including some who struggle only in winter, mostly report no stripping and a soft, hydrated finish, though one reviewer with dry/normal skin says it stripped her barrier and caused redness, texture and whiteheads.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as balancing, reducing oil without tightness, though a couple note slight dryness afterward.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with rosacea or fragrance-triggered migraines, repeatedly call it gentle and non-irritating, but a small number report drying effects or a strong lingering smell despite the fragrance-free label.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s-60s describe it as gentle, non-drying and suitable alongside other Round Lab products for aging or reactive mature skin.
segments.normal: The one reviewer identifying as having normal (non-acne, non-sensitive) skin reports it severely stripped her barrier and caused whiteheads.

concerns.aging: Reviewers over 40 or self-described as mature/middle-aged report the cleanser feels gentle, non-stripping and compatible with anti-aging routines, with no negative reports specific to this group.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it does not leave skin tight or stripped and even feels hydrating; several others explicitly report dryness, tightness, or a dehydrated feel afterward, including one whose hands also dried out.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness or rosacea report it does not trigger flare-ups and feels calming; one reviewer says it is gentle on her redness though not particularly hydrating.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers state it does not strip or compromise the skin barrier and even helped barrier repair; one reviewer reports the opposite, that it stripped her barrier and caused lasting irritation requiring a dermatologist visit.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with clogged pores/small bumps after two weeks asks whether this is purging; another mentions dark spots persisting despite improvement from acne.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple acne-prone reviewers report reduced breakouts, clearer skin, or acne fading over weeks of use; one long-time acne sufferer says breakouts minimized but still occur, and one reviewer developed whiteheads after use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers say it removes sebum and oil thoroughly and leaves skin feeling fresh rather than greasy, with no dissenting reports on oil control.

extraits.titre: not for dry skin at all
extraits.texte: i have never had acne in my life and i don't have sensitive skin. i used this face wash once a day for 5 days and it completely stripped my skin barrier. it became red, itchy, textured, and little whiteheads everywhere. that was a month ago and my skin is still trying to recover after using this, even after having to see a dermatologist. if you have dry or even normal skin, i would steer clear. i can't even look at myself in the mirror without crying it really ruined my skin.

I really wanted to love this cleanser because of all the positive reviews, but my experience has been mixed. I have combination to dry sensitive skin and was looking for a water-based cleanser for my AM simple routine and PM double-cleansing routine. The cleanser foams easily and does a good job of cleaning. Its lightweight texture spreads smoothly across the face, but it leaves my skin feeling dehydrated and in need of moisture. Surprisingly, it also dries out my hands, which I have never experienced with a facial cleanser before. Following up immediately with toner and moisturizer helps a little, but my skin still feels tighter than I would like. The biggest issue for me is the smell. Even though it is labeled fragrance-free, the scent is surprisingly strong and somewhat unpleasant. It reminds me a lot of Dove Sensitive bar soap, the classic "clean soap" smell. I do not mind it on my body, but having it on my face means the scent lingers near my nose, which makes the experience less enjoyable. If you are sensitive to smells or prefer truly neutral fragrance-free products, this could be a dealbreaker. I will continue using it to see if my skin eventually adjusts, but this has been my experience so far after multiple uses. Overall, it cleans effectively, but the dryness and smell make it difficult to fully enjoy or recommend as a daily option.

I have oily skin with blackheads, medium size pores, and slightly acne prone. I have tried SO MANY viral face washes and havent truly loved any of them. Either they dont lather, make my skin feel like its being stripped, or they dont make my skin feel clean enough. This cleanser is foamy and soft and a little goes a long way to lather. It feels very soft on my skin and makes my skin feel clean after one wash (with wash cloth). I feel this cleanser actually working into my skin rather then just a thick film. My skin feels soft, glowy, and clean afterwards. So happy i found a face wash that I love. Couldnt be happier! Time to find the perfect moisturizer.

Love love love this cleansing cream. It cleans beautifully, especially oaired with the corresponding cleansing oil. It is scentless, which is critical for me as scents irritate my skin and give me migraines! It is SO gentle, but hardcore effective. I have very sensitive middle-aged skin, and the wrong product can give me zits, raw spots, or peeling and burning areas. The ingredients are all super "clean", rating an 'excellent' on the yuka app & on the EWG website. I've bought this cleanser duo for friends and all of them are now hooked! I cannot recommend this product or the partnering oil cleanser any more highly for an excellent double cleansing routine for highly sensitive skin.

I am above 40, and have combination sensitive skin, hormonal acne, and wear makeup. My skin lately seems to be irritated and reacting differently to products that used to work. So, I thought I would switch to Round lab products. This Dodko cleanser is a gane changer for me: it lathers with just a teeny bit of it., skin feels super clean without the feeling of it being stripped., and I have no skin irritations. I was so pleased that I purchased several other Round lab products and so far my skin is happy.

The 1025 Dokdo Cleanser cleanses my skin without stripping. 1025 leaves my skin clear of oil, dirt & flakes. Although I am 64, my skin is still very oily. 1025 cleans deep without drying. Now that I use 1025 daily, my skin is smoother and balanced.

My skin is super super sensitive as I have rosacea so I was scared to try this cleanser out. I love it so much. I usually it daily and it's gentle and gets all my makeup off after using a cleansing balm!
